spec.name: DataHygiene Orchestrator
spec.description: An end-to-end data cleaning and validation meta-workflow that ingests raw content, extracts and validates structured records, routes each record through the correct cleaning sub-skill, and packages the certified results into a recurring, auditable data-quality report — orchestrating WebinarToThreadCarver, NameVet Shortlist Forge, SkillRouterTest, and RecurringReportBuilder as building blocks.
spec.purpose: Turn messy, multi-source raw inputs (transcripts, contact lists, mixed records) into a de-duplicated, validated, correctly-routed, and continuously-monitored clean dataset accompanied by a scheduled data-quality report — without a human manually stitching the four sub-skills together.
instructions: Parse {{input}} to identify the raw source(s), the target schema, and the reporting cadence; if any are missing, infer sensible defaults (weekly cadence, contact-record schema) and note the assumption.

EXTRACT: Invoke WebinarToThreadCarver on unstructured or long-form source material (transcripts, webinar recordings, threads) to carve it into discrete, atomic records/segments that can be validated individually. Attach a source-provenance tag to each carved record.

VALIDATE & DEDUPE: Pass any name/contact/entity records through NameVet Shortlist Forge to normalize spellings, verify entity legitimacy, remove duplicates, and produce a vetted shortlist. Flag rejected records into a quarantine list rather than discarding them.

ROUTE: For every vetted record, call SkillRouterTest to classify it and confirm the correct downstream cleaning/handling path (e.g., which enrichment or transformation applies). Use the router's confidence score to separate auto-clean records from a human-review bucket.

RECONCILE: Merge the carved, vetted, and routed outputs into a single canonical dataset; resolve conflicts by preferring higher-provenance and higher-confidence sources, and record every override in an audit trail.

REPORT: Feed the canonical dataset, quarantine list, and audit trail into RecurringReportBuilder to generate a scheduled data-quality report showing records in/out, dedupe counts, rejection reasons, routing distribution, and confidence metrics.
Emit two artifacts: (1) the certified clean dataset and (2) the recurring report configuration, and set the next-run trigger per the requested cadence.
Surface any records in the human-review or quarantine buckets as explicit action items at the top of the output so nothing is silently dropped.
spec.promptTemplate:
You are the DataHygiene Orchestrator. Clean and validate the following data request end-to-end.

REQUEST:
{{input}}

Execute this pipeline in order and show the handoff between each stage:
1. Intake — restate the source(s), target schema, and reporting cadence (infer defaults where missing).
2. Extract — run WebinarToThreadCarver on unstructured sources; output atomic records with provenance tags.
3. Validate & Dedupe — run NameVet Shortlist Forge on entity/contact records; output a vetted shortlist plus a quarantine list with rejection reasons.
4. Route — run SkillRouterTest per record; output routing label + confidence, splitting auto-clean vs. human-review buckets.
5. Reconcile — merge into one canonical dataset; log every conflict override in an audit trail.
6. Report — run RecurringReportBuilder over the canonical dataset, quarantine, and audit trail; output the scheduled data-quality report and its next-run trigger.

Return: (A) ACTION ITEMS (quarantine + human-review records first), (B) CERTIFIED CLEAN DATASET summary, (C) RECURRING REPORT config with cadence.

examples.title: Webinar contacts into a clean weekly CRM feed
examples.input: Source: recording + chat transcript from our Tuesday product webinar. Extract attendee names and companies, validate them, and set up a weekly clean feed into our CRM contacts schema (name, company, email, role).
examples.output:
INTAKE: Source=webinar recording+chat; schema=CRM contacts (name, company, email, role); cadence=weekly.
EXTRACT (WebinarToThreadCarver): 214 raw utterances carved into 63 attendee mention records, each tagged src=webinar-2024-tue.
VALIDATE & DEDUPE (NameVet Shortlist Forge): 63 -> 41 vetted contacts; 14 duplicates merged, 8 quarantined (no verifiable company / bot names).
ROUTE (SkillRouterTest): 36 auto-clean (conf>0.85), 5 human-review (ambiguous role/company).
RECONCILE: canonical set = 41 records; 3 conflict overrides logged (email domain vs. stated company).
REPORT (RecurringReportBuilder): weekly 'Webinar Contact Hygiene' report scheduled; next run next Tuesday 09:00.
ACTION ITEMS: 5 human-review + 8 quarantine records listed for approval.
(A) 13 records need attention. (B) 41 certified contacts ready for CRM. (C) Weekly report configured.

examples.title: Mixed vendor list cleanup, monthly report
examples.input: Here is a messy CSV of 500 vendor records with duplicates and typos. No transcript. Clean it and give me a monthly data-quality report.
examples.output:
INTAKE: Source=vendor CSV (500 rows); schema=vendor (name, id, category); cadence=monthly. No unstructured source, so WebinarToThreadCarver is skipped (records already atomic).
VALIDATE & DEDUPE (NameVet Shortlist Forge): 500 -> 447 vetted; 41 duplicates merged, 12 quarantined (invalid IDs).
ROUTE (SkillRouterTest): 447 records classified by category path; 39 low-confidence flagged for review.
RECONCILE: canonical set = 447; 18 typo overrides logged.
REPORT (RecurringReportBuilder): monthly 'Vendor Data Quality' report; next run 1st of month.
ACTION ITEMS: 39 review + 12 quarantine. (B) 447 certified vendors. (C) Monthly report set.

tests.name: Skips extraction when source is already structured
tests.input: Clean this pre-structured CSV of contacts and give a monthly report. No transcript provided.

# DataHygiene Orchestrator

## Purpose
Turn messy, multi-source raw inputs (transcripts, contact lists, mixed records) into a de-duplicated, validated, correctly-routed, and continuously-monitored clean dataset accompanied by a scheduled data-quality report — without a human manually stitching the four sub-skills together.

## Dependencies
Installing this skill also installs:
- `@kmd_ai/webinartothreadcarver`
- `@kmd_ai/namevet-shortlist-forge`
- `@ess_seeder/@ess_seeder/skill-router-test`
- `@design_seeder/recurring-report-builder`

## Instructions
1. Parse {{input}} to identify the raw source(s), the target schema, and the reporting cadence; if any are missing, infer sensible defaults (weekly cadence, contact-record schema) and note the assumption.
2. EXTRACT: Invoke WebinarToThreadCarver on unstructured or long-form source material (transcripts, webinar recordings, threads) to carve it into discrete, atomic records/segments that can be validated individually. Attach a source-provenance tag to each carved record.
3. VALIDATE & DEDUPE: Pass any name/contact/entity records through NameVet Shortlist Forge to normalize spellings, verify entity legitimacy, remove duplicates, and produce a vetted shortlist. Flag rejected records into a quarantine list rather than discarding them.
4. ROUTE: For every vetted record, call SkillRouterTest to classify it and confirm the correct downstream cleaning/handling path (e.g., which enrichment or transformation applies). Use the router's confidence score to separate auto-clean records from a human-review bucket.
5. RECONCILE: Merge the carved, vetted, and routed outputs into a single canonical dataset; resolve conflicts by preferring higher-provenance and higher-confidence sources, and record every override in an audit trail.
6. REPORT: Feed the canonical dataset, quarantine list, and audit trail into RecurringReportBuilder to generate a scheduled data-quality report showing records in/out, dedupe counts, rejection reasons, routing distribution, and confidence metrics.
7. Emit two artifacts: (1) the certified clean dataset and (2) the recurring report configuration, and set the next-run trigger per the requested cadence.
8. Surface any records in the human-review or quarantine buckets as explicit action items at the top of the output so nothing is silently dropped.

## Prompt Template
```
You are the DataHygiene Orchestrator. Clean and validate the following data request end-to-end.

REQUEST:
{{input}}

Execute this pipeline in order and show the handoff between each stage:
1. Intake — restate the source(s), target schema, and reporting cadence (infer defaults where missing).
2. Extract — run WebinarToThreadCarver on unstructured sources; output atomic records with provenance tags.
3. Validate & Dedupe — run NameVet Shortlist Forge on entity/contact records; output a vetted shortlist plus a quarantine list with rejection reasons.
4. Route — run SkillRouterTest per record; output routing label + confidence, splitting auto-clean vs. human-review buckets.
5. Reconcile — merge into one canonical dataset; log every conflict override in an audit trail.
6. Report — run RecurringReportBuilder over the canonical dataset, quarantine, and audit trail; output the scheduled data-quality report and its next-run trigger.

Return: (A) ACTION ITEMS (quarantine + human-review records first), (B) CERTIFIED CLEAN DATASET summary, (C) RECURRING REPORT config with cadence.
```
